## Checklist

- [ ] `make lint test race` passes locally
- [ ] Tests added/updated for new behaviour
- [ ] Docs updated (README / docs/*) if behaviour or flags changed
- [ ] No real account IDs, start URLs, hostnames, credentials or tokens anywhere (tests use synthetic data)
- [ ] Commit messages follow Conventional Commits (`feat:`, `fix:`, `docs:` …)
